_hinweis: Action card archive, transcribed by the player from his own deck (no card data ships with this kit). One entry per card number. Fields: commands (helmet number), initiative (small number in the star), attempt (word/symbol top right), symbole (icons), at, combat (NCM -4..+6 -> HIT/PIN/MISS), hit_effect (Vet/Line/Green letters), zufall (random number columns '2'..'12' = R2..R12).
